robot.name: Unitree R1
robot.status_notes: Official Unitree shop lists R1 as a pre-sale product, with shipments beginning in June 2026; base versions do not support secondary development.

currentness.currentness_notes: Current low-cost Unitree humanoid product family.

payload.notes: Official figure, added 2026-10-29 by automated spec fill; per arm; maximum arm load varies by extension posture.

battery.notes: Not found in reviewed public sources.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: R1 listed at 26 DoF; R1 Air 20; EDU 26-40.

hands.description: No dexterous hand on R1 Air or R1; dexterous hand is optional on R1 EDU only.

items: binocular camera on R1 and R1 EDU

compute.description: Official parameter table lists an 8-core high-performance CPU across R1 Air, R1, and R1 EDU; NVIDIA Jetson Orin 40-100 TOPS is optional for R1 EDU only.

actuators.description: Official table lists low-inertia high-speed internal-rotor PMSM joint motors, 6 DoF per leg, 4-5 DoF per arm, and crossed-roller/double-hook ball bearings.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: Base R1 Air/R1 lack dexterous hands; Unitree lists dexterous hands only as an R1 EDU option, so manipulation evidence is very weak for retail base models.
caveats: No public R1 task-manipulation benchmark was found.
Do not credit base R1 Air/R1 with dexterous manipulation.
EDU hand options are not evidence of shipped autonomous manipulation performance.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: Unitree markets multimodal speech/image functions and open joint/sensor interfaces, but no independent task-autonomy benchmark or real deployment data was found.
caveats: Marketing claims about multimodal AI are not task-completion metrics.
Base shop listing explicitly says the product does not support secondary development.
No public failure-rate or intervention-rate data was found.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Company demo evidence for dynamic mobility; no useful deployment.
caveats: No independent benchmark was found in this pass.
Public demos may be edited, staged, or teleoperation-ambiguous unless specifically noted.
No public failure-rate or intervention-rate data was found.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: Official specs list cameras, audio I/O, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and multimodal speech/image claims, but no independent scene-understanding benchmark was found.
caveats: Sensor presence is not evidence of robust perception.
No public benchmark for object recognition, localization, or scene understanding was found.
No third-party test of the multimodal model was found.

human_interaction.summary: Official sources claim integrated speech/image multimodal AI and list microphone/speaker hardware; evidence remains hardware/marketing-level only.
caveats: No independent dialogue or HRI benchmark was found.
No customer deployment involving human-facing tasks was found.
Marketing copy should not be scored as reliable interaction autonomy.

endurance_reliability.summary: Official runtime is about 1 hour and warranty is 6-12 months depending on model; no reliability, uptime, or field-hour data was found.
caveats: Runtime is a company specification.
Warranty is not a reliability benchmark.
No public failure-rate or intervention-rate data was found.

human_environment_fit.summary: R1 is a compact 123 cm, 27-29 kg biped aimed at early-stage research and software developers, but lacks proof of useful work in homes or workplaces.
caveats: Human-scale form factor is not proof of human-environment task success.
No home, office, or industrial R1 deployment metrics were found.
No payload spec was found.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Official Unitree shop lists R1 as a pre-sale product with June 2026 shipments, and media reports overseas sales via AliExpress; no customer operations were found.
caveats: Pre-sale availability is not operational deployment.
No named customer deployment with task, hours, or output was found.
AliExpress/media price references vary with import fees and configuration.

accessibility_value.summary: Official pricing starts at $4,900 for R1 Air and $5,900 for R1, with direct shop pre-sale availability, making accessibility the strongest R1 evidence category.
caveats: Tax, shipping, customs, import clearance, and configuration can materially change delivered cost.
EDU and advanced configurations require sales contact.
Low price does not imply useful autonomous task performance.

evidence_items.title: Official R1 specs and price
evidence_items.claim: Unitree lists R1 Air at 4900 USD and R1 at 5900 USD, with 1230 x 357 x 190 mm dimensions, about 27-29 kg weight, 20-26 DoF, and about 1 hour battery life.
evidence_items.notes: Official page includes configuration caveats and price excludes tax and shipping.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Official R1 page lists model tiers, dimensions, weight, DoF, battery, and pricing.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Company source; current price should be rechecked.

evidence_items.title: Acrobatic launch demo
evidence_items.claim: Launch coverage described company video showing cartwheels, handstands, shadowboxing, and rough-terrain running.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Notebookcheck describes launch video capabilities and viewer skepticism.
evidence_items.verification_notes: No independent benchmark or useful task proof.

evidence_items.title: Official shop pre-sale and base model limitations
evidence_items.claim: Unitree's official shop lists R1 pre-sale at 4900 USD, says shipments begin in June 2026, and states that the product does not support secondary development unless buyers choose the EDU edition via sales contact.
evidence_items.notes: Primary source for current purchase flow and base-model caveat; not evidence of completed deliveries or field deployment.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Strong evidence for purchasability/pre-sale and a negative caveat for base developer autonomy.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Official shop lists $4,900, June 2026 shipments, shipping/import caveats, and no secondary development for the non-EDU product.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Company storefront; availability and shipment timing should be rechecked because pre-sale listings can change.

evidence_items.title: Official sensors, compute, and dexterous hand configuration
evidence_items.claim: Unitree lists microphone array, speaker, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, cameras, 8-core CPU, and optional EDU-only Jetson Orin and dexterous hand configurations; R1 Air and R1 show no dexterous hand.
evidence_items.notes: Hardware and configuration evidence only; does not establish robust perception, interaction, or manipulation performance.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Clarifies what can and cannot be credited on base R1 models.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Official parameter table lists cameras, audio, wireless, CPU, optional EDU compute, and dexterous-hand availability.
evidence_items.source_location: Unitree R1 parameter table and shop description
evidence_items.verification_notes: Primary source; no third-party teardown or benchmark found.

evidence_items.title: Independent framing as early-stage research/software platform
evidence_items.claim: Engineering magazine described the R1 as a 121 cm robot that Unitree planned to sell for 5900 USD and aimed at early-stage research groups and software engineers building on the H1/G1 software stack.
evidence_items.notes: Credible independent framing, but it does not add R1 deployment or benchmark proof.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Supports classifying R1 as a research/developer platform rather than a proven service robot.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Engineering describes R1's price/size and target audience as early-stage researchers and software engineers.
evidence_items.source_location: Engineering 54 (2025), Chinese Robotics Take a Big (Dance) Step Forward
evidence_items.verification_notes: Secondary technical magazine source; use for positioning, not performance scoring.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: Official sources claim multimodal speech/image functions, but no independent task-execution benchmark was found.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Score conservatively; do not infer missing capability.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: Official shop pre-sale and media-reported overseas sales do not establish any completed customer deployment or operating-hour record.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Score conservatively; do not infer missing capability.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: No public failure-rate, uptime, intervention-rate, or field-hour data was found.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Score conservatively; do not infer missing capability.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: Official sources indicate R1 Air/R1 lack dexterous hands and secondary development support; those are reserved for EDU/contact-sales configurations.
limitations_and_unknowns.impact_on_arena_scoring: Score conservatively; do not infer missing capability.

excluded_claims.reason: Official page and shop reserve secondary development and advanced options for EDU/contact-sales configurations.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Unitree R1 is a low-cost humanoid in official pre-sale, with strong price/accessibility evidence, clear base-model limitations, and company-controlled mobility demos; no useful task deployment, independent autonomy benchmark, or field reliability evidence was found.
strongest_evidence: Official $4,900 R1 Air / $5,900 R1 price table
Official shop pre-sale with June 2026 shipment timing
Official base-model caveat: no secondary development and no dexterous hand
weakest_evidence: No independent autonomy or manipulation benchmark

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: Unitree R1 is a current low-cost pre-sale humanoid platform with strong accessibility evidence but weak task/deployment proof.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official $4,900 entry price and shop pre-sale
conflicting_claims: Some launch coverage says starting at 5900 USD, while current official pages list R1 Air at 4900 USD and R1 at 5900 USD.
AliExpress/global-sale reports include import fees and configuration differences, so delivered prices can be higher than official base price.
do_not_overclaim: Autonomous useful household or industrial task execution
